fields.description: The DNS record type to create at the provider.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: The name to create, relative to the domain; @ is the domain itself. Providers that want the full name get host, a dot and the domain.
fields.label: Host

fields.description: What the record must hold. For MX and SRV it is the target hostname alone; priority, weight and port are their own fields. A long TXT value is shown as one string even where the provider splits it into chunks.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: The protocol the record serves. The table the row sits in is its group.
fields.label: Category
fields.options:
MX
SPF
DKIM
DMARC
MTA-STS
TLS-RPT
SRV
Autoconfig
Autodiscover
UA Auto Config

fields.description: MX and SRV use it: lower is preferred. Zero for every other type.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: SRV only: how load is shared among records of the same priority. Zero for every other type.
fields.label: Weight

fields.description: SRV only: the port the service listens on at the target named in Value. Zero for every other type.
fields.label: Port

fields.description: How long resolvers may cache the record, in seconds. A suggestion from the zone file or the Suite Cloud default; providers often apply their own.
fields.label: TTL

fields.description: Set when the record resolved to the expected value on public resolvers at the last check. Kept across refreshes while the value stays the same.
fields.label: Verified

fields.description: Set on the rows that decide whether the domain is verified: the Email Authentication group.
fields.label: Mandatory

fields.description: When the record was last resolved. Empty until the first verification; a lookup that could not be resolved leaves it unchanged.
fields.label: Last Checked At
